findings.quote: Of the 8,740 quality improvement proposals, approximately half have already been implemented.
The training hours of 35.2 hours referred to above increased from the previous consolidatedfiscal year.
The safety education of 16.8 hours referred to above is provided at all production bases.
The average funding rate on interest-bearing debt of 116,600 million yen has remained low.
Of the 1,680 patents held by the Group, approximately 40% are registered overseas.
The ratio of overseas net sales of 34.8% increased from the previous consolidatedfiscal year.
Of the 1,427 employees at overseas bases, managers are mainly locally hired.
Of the water consumption of 512,900 cubic meters, industrial water accounts for the majority.
The ratio of female employees of 27.1% increased from the previous consolidatedfiscal year.
Of the electricity consumption of 67,320 megawatt-hours, the ratio derived from renewable energy is rising.
Of the 3,490 tons of industrial waste, the proportion recycled is rising year by year.
The average age of production facilities of 14.2 years is used as a basis for deciding on replacement investment.
Greenhouse gas emissions of 49,130 tons exceeded the previous consolidated fiscal year due to the increase in production volume.

uncertain_candidates.quote: The results of in-line inspection are compiled monthly by the quality assurance department.
The total area of production bases of 248,500 square meters includes leased land.
The 12,840 units shipped are divided almost evenly between domestic and overseas destinations.
